nom: Vichy Normaderm Daily Deep Cleansing with Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Oily skin is the most frequently named skin type, with reviewers reporting reduced shine and better-controlled oil, including a man and a reviewer in her seventies who developed oily, clog-prone skin later in life.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some find it leaves their face feeling dry and tight, while at least one with sensitive dry skin calls it the only cleanser that does not break her out or over-dry her skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally describe it as balancing oily and dry areas at once, several pairing it successfully with the matching moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin frequently report it does not irritate them despite containing salicylic acid, though a few note bumps or dryness after about a week of use.
segments.normal: One reviewer self-describes her skin as normal, sensitive, acne-prone, and dark-spot-prone, and reports the cleanser helped with acne but not with dark spots or dirt removal.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin and fewer breakouts with regular use, some after purging in the first weeks, but a notable minority say it did nothing for their acne or even coincided with more breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently report less shine and better oil control, including several who call it their best option for oily or acne-prone skin.
concerns.dehydration: Reports on dryness are mixed: several reviewers, including one whose husband also used it, describe it as drying and tightening, while others, including one with sensitive dry skin, say it does not dry them out at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits it with helping restore a damaged skin barrier that had been causing constant breakouts; another reports her barrier recovering alongside continued use.
concerns.spots: Effects on dark spots and acne scarring are mixed: one reviewer reports it did not fade her dark spots, while others describe their acne scars lightening with continued use of the cleanser and matching moisturizer.

aspects.libelle: Lathers well from a small amount
Distinct medicinal or earthy scent bothers some
Does not fully remove makeup or dirt on its own
A little product lasts a long time
Works best paired with the matching Normaderm moisturizer

extraits.titre: At first I thought it was great…
extraits.texte: After using this product for weeks, my face has broken out even more than before. Not sure if it is related but just saying it did not clear my skin.

This cleanser did get rid of acne for the most part. Didn't help with cleansing pores (not that it states it will completely) or getting rid of dark spots. My skin texture improved slightly. One thing it did not do absolutely at all was remove dirt off of my face. I would double cleanse with this every evening and then use my Paula's choice liquid exfoliant and their would still be lots of dirt on the cotton pad. It is decent at removing mascara but obviously not waterproof kind. SKIN TYPE: Normal. Sensitive. Acne prone. Dark spot prone. Clog pores on nose and chin.

extraits.titre: It's just ok, acne has increased
extraits.texte: Did not dry out my skin but it didn't do anything my usual products doesn't. My husband has been using this and it does dry his skin out, makes it feel tight. I will likely discontinue this. So far I do have an uptick in acne along my chin and hairline. More than a 50% increase in pimples from prior to using these products.

extraits.titre: Works great but I don't like the smell
extraits.texte: At 75 years young, I never thought I'd develop oily skin, but I had problems with persistent oil clogging the pores in my naso-labial folds, upper lip and chin. Nothing I did seem to work and even cleansers designed for oily skin did not work at all. So I decided to try products with salicylic acid in them, ordered this cleanser and this did work! Along with a 2% salicylic acid serum, my skin was once again clear and new clogged pores stopped appearing. I alternate this cleanser with a 2% salicylic acid cleanser and it keeps my skin balanced and clog free. My only complaint is the smell. It is not pleasant, smells a little like "dirt" or composting plants - but since my skin likes it (no redness or peeling) and it works, I'll keep using it. Just PLEASE - do something about the smell!

extraits.titre: Perfect one step cleansing for the most sensitive dry skin
extraits.texte: I actually got a sample of this last year from ULTA, and so glad I gave it chance since it does say it's for oily skin - but I've had problems with acne breaking out if I use the wrong kind of cleanser even if they're specifically made for dry skin. I need a very delicate balance between feeling like all the day's dirt and my skincare and makeup is all completely off without doubt but not leaving my skin dried out. For reference the FAB face cleanser breaks me out after one use and the Drunk Elephant jelly cleanser leaves my skin dried out and suffering immediately as well. The other French Pharmacy staple brands' cleansers don't suit my needs either: LRP's Toleraine one feels a bit drying and doesn't get makeup off perfectly in one go, and Avene's gentle lotion leaves a film that makes me keep feeling like my skin is dirty & doesn't do well against makeup or sunscreen. So a very tough job to find the cleanser suited to me. This cleanser saved my skin when I was suffering from my damaged skin barrier causing constant breakouts - so my skin was in immense constant pain as well. This gel cleanser is so good that I barely need a dot to lather all around my face and neck to get every last drop of anything on my face off - including mascara. I really like how this lathers to spread a lot but it isn't foamy to the point I can't see exactly how my skin products are coming off or where I need to spread cleanser to. This never causes any stinging despite having BHA in it which is such

extraits.titre: Worked great on my sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I'm 37 years old and still get the occasional acne around my chin area I was hesitant about using this product because I have very sensitive skin. After trying it for about a week I really noticed a difference in my skin how the pores looked cleaner and I didn't have flareups in my acne prone areas anymore. It also did not irritate my skin like other acne cleansers have.

extraits.titre: Foams up well, doesn't dry out skin!
extraits.texte: My skin used to be much more acne prone than it is now but even in my late 30's, I still experience blackheads and breakouts. Ugh! I also have combination skin - oily in some areas, dry in others - so finding that perfect product that doesn't leave my skin looking shiny or flaky can be tricky. The Normaderm PhytoAction Daily Deep Cleansing Gel is a lightweight gel formula that does a great job cleansing my skin without drying it. Most acne cleansers clean well but leave my skin feeling stripped of moisture and overly tight. I have been using this for around a month and have noticed some results. Granted, my skin isn't in really bad shape like it used to be but I do have some blemishes and also some minor blackheads around my nose area. When used in combination with the Vichy Laboratories Vichy Laboratories Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Moisturizer, my problem areas have pretty much vanished. No more blemishes, no more blackheads (which is HUGE), and my pores appear to be considerably smaller. I was getting frustrated at first because I didn't see results for awhile. So, keep trying! The deep cleansing gel foams up nicely. You don't need to use a lot to work up a nice lather. (1-2 pumps was plenty for me) The scent is light and fresh smelling. After rinsing, my skin felt soft, clean, fresh, and best of all, not overly tight or dry.
